references.text: Joshua sent spies out secretly, which shows the use of covert operations in war and conflict in Israel.
Joshua set an ambush against Ai, illustrating military tactics involving ambushes in ancient Israel.
Abimelech and his men lay in wait for Shechem at night, the same conflict and tactic as verse 25.
The continuation of the conflict between Abimelech and the inhabitants of Shechem.
Abimelech's final attack on Shechem as a result of the hostility that began with the ambush.
Robbers lay in wait by the road, using tactics similar to those employed by the leaders of Shechem against Abimelech.
Priestly bands acting like robber gangs lying in ambush along the road, parallel to robbery and ambushes in the mountains.
